Title: Golf Ball Dispenser
Body (HTML):
A gravity fed golf ball dispenser for simulator bays, backyard nets, and range sessions. Tap it with a club or your foot and the next ball drops into place. No motor, no batteries, no power required.

Holds up to 25 golf balls. Printed in UV resistant PETG in our own workshop.

Classic includes the base, ball guider, pedal, hopper, and adjustable legs. Premium adds a funnel for smoother ball delivery.

Color combinations: Patriot's Drive, Augusta Aura, Caddie, Golden Tee, Ocean Drive, Tiger's Roar, or request a custom combo.

Is it powered? No, it runs on gravity and a tap. Does it work for left and right handed golfers? Yes, the same for both. Will it work with my simulator? Yes, it is designed to keep the hitting area clean and repeatable.

Title: Personalized Keycap Fidget Clicker Keychain, Custom Name or Word Sensory Toy, 3D Printed Gift
